newsitem.title: USA: Universal sees no immediate tobacco impact.
newsitem.headline: Universal sees no immediate tobacco impact.

text.p: Universal Outdoor Holdings Inc said Monday it does not expect an immediate impact on its business from rumored negoitiations on eliminating tobacco advertising on billboards.

"We do not expect any immediate impact upon our business from the rumored negotiations for settlement of the tobacco litigation," Daniel Simon, president of the outdoor advertising company, said in a statement.

Universal cited recent reports on the possible elimination of billboard tobacco advertising, but said it has no information on the reports and can not speculate whether such an action will be proposed or eventually approved.

"Even if a ban on billboard advertising of tobacco is eventually upheld, Universal believes replacement revenues would be obtained from other advertisers interested in prime locations occupied by tobacco advertisers," Simon said.
Universal's pro forma 1996 net revenues from tobacco advertisers accounted for about 10.8 percent of its net revenues, the company said.
